listings.title: Mount Laurel Online Estate Auction: Fine Art, Leather Furniture & Collectibles
listings.description: All items in this auction are from a smoke-free, pet-free home. The items have been properly stored and well cared for. Welcome to this premier Mount Laurel, NJ online estate auction presented by B&B Estate Sales. This curated auction features the high-quality contents of a beautifully maintained local residence, showcasing an exceptional selection of fine art, premium home furnishings, and highly sought-after collectibles. Bidding is open now and runs through Saturday, October 24th. Complementing these works is a selection of fine home furnishings, featuring a premium dark brown Oskar Huber leather loveseat, a matching pair of burgundy patterned La-Z-Boy wingback recliners, a large Tiffany-style stained glass table lamp, and a professional Bob Ross studio easel complete with palette and canvas. Collectors will find an outstanding assortment of themed collector plates, including authentic Norman Rockwell series, Frank Sinatra musical plates by the Franklin Mint, Mark McGwire Home Run Hero plates, and festive holiday collections by artists Jean Sias, Lloyd Garrison, and Dona Gelsinger. Please review all terms and conditions before bidding. Local pickup is required at the conclusion of the sale, with shipping options available for select smaller items.

listings.description: Fixed 2 Move is pleased to host a wonderful estate sale event in Exton, PA, offering a diverse array of vintage goods, workshop equipment, and outdoor living items. listings.description: B&B Estate Sales is pleased to present a wonderful estate sale in Moorestown, New Jersey, featuring an eclectic mix of vintage collectibles, mid-century furniture, and nostalgic retro items. Among the highlights of this sale is a highly sought-after 1972 Williams "Spanish Eyes" pinball machine, boasting vibrant, psychedelic graphics on both the backglass and cabinet. Collectors will also find an array of vintage toys and recreational items, including an Aurora Model Motoring Real Racing slot car set in its original box, a classic Wonder Horse spring rocking horse, a vintage Welsh baby stroller, and retro plastic snowboards from Riva and Sledz. For those looking to furnish or decorate, the home offers a beautiful French Provincial style dining set with a cream-painted finish and gold trim, a set of six mid-century folding chairs with teal vinyl seats, and a classic Windsor-style armchair. Decorative highlights include a stunning Tiffany-style stained glass table lamp with a floral tulip motif, a colorful songbird stained glass window panel, and vintage holiday decor. Audiophiles and media enthusiasts will appreciate the vintage Garrard Synchro-Lab 72B turntable, a selection of classic vinyl records, and quality home audio components from Sony and Samsung. Also, vintage draft table. This sale will take place on-site in Moorestown, NJ (08057). We accept all major credit cards, Venmo, as well as cash.
